mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission (code, oauth_scope, resource, action, status, description) VALUES (#{code}, #{oauthScope}, #{resource}, #{action}, #{status}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET code = #{code}, oauth_scope = #{oauthScope}, resource = #{resource}, action = #{action}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
